_note: College football overrides for concept cards whose rules differ from the NFL (2026 NCAA rules, to be reviewed by the team). Only the listed fields change.

holding_defensive.short: Defender grabbed a player without the ball.
holding_defensive.full: Defensive holding: a defender grabbed or held a receiver or blocker who didn't have the ball. In college it's 10 yards, with no automatic first down.
holding_defensive.detail: 10 yards (no automatic first down in college).

pass_interference_defensive.full: Defensive pass interference: a defender blocked a receiver's fair chance to catch a catchable pass. In college: up to 15 yards and an automatic first down.
pass_interference_defensive.detail: 15 yards (or the spot of the foul if that's shorter) + automatic first down.

pass_interference_offensive.full: Offensive pass interference: a receiver pushed off or blocked a defender while the pass was in the air. In college it's 15 yards.

offside.full: Offside: a player was across the line of scrimmage when the ball was snapped. It's a 5-yard penalty.

touchback.full: A touchback is a kick downed in or through the end zone. There's no return; the receiving team starts from a set spot.
touchback.detail: For punts, that spot is the receiving team's own 20.
